topic: SIBO: small intestinal bacterial overgrowth explained
caption: Did you know 1 in 5 people suffer from SIBO? 🌟 Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth is a condition where bacteria overgrow in the small intestine, causing bloating, abdominal pain, and malabsorption. 🤯 Research shows 75% of IBS patients have SIBO. 📊 The main symptoms include bloating, gas, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. 🌡️ Treatment options include antibiotics, probiotics, and dietary changes. 🥗 Save this so you don't lose it.
